main.description: Prefix search for atproto actors, ordered for typeahead use. Served entirely from a community-run index (https://typeahead.waow.tech); unauthenticated, CORS-enabled, results edge-cached for 60s. Also served at app.bsky.actor.searchActorsTypeahead as a drop-in migration alias with an identical response.

q.description: Search prefix; matched case-insensitively against handles and display names (CJK display names are matched via bigrams).

pds.description: Optional exact hosting PDS hostname, e.g. acme.com. Case-insensitive; HTTP(S) origin and trailing slash/dot accepted, ports and paths rejected. Filters before candidate selection, including custom-domain handles. Scopes cover PDSs with at most 10,000 known actors at build time (configurable). Unknown PDS returns no actors; larger PDSs or unavailable scope support return HTTP 503 PdsScopeUnavailable.

limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return.

prefer_pds.description: Capability-gated candidate extension: prefer this canonical hosting PDS without filtering global results. Defaults to PDS-first ranking; exact eligible handles retain priority. Unsupported preference returns503 PdsScopeUnavailable. Independent of the hard pds filter.

preference.description: PDS preference mode; requires prefer_pds. pds_first is the default unless boost is supplied. boost mode requires boost. Combining pds_first with boost is invalid.

boost.description: Finite nonnegative decimal score boost, rounded to f32. Requires prefer_pds and implies boost mode unless preference is explicit. Unknown source hosting metadata receives no preference.

errors.name: PdsScopeUnavailable
errors.description: PDS-scoped search is not available on the current backend or snapshot.

errors.name: SearchBackendUnavailable
errors.description: The selected search backend is unavailable, stale or returned an invalid response; never a successful empty fallback.

actors.description: Matching actors, best match first. Ranking blends prefix quality with a stored popularity score; actors hidden by moderation are excluded.

actorBasic.description: Basic actor profile. Matches the shape of app.bsky.actor.defs#profileViewBasic minus the authenticated viewer state, so results are interchangeable with bluesky's for unauthenticated use.

handle.description: The actor's current handle, e.g. zzstoatzz.io.

displayName.description: Self-declared display name from the actor's profile record; absent if unset.

avatar.description: Avatar image URL — usually a bluesky CDN URL, but may point directly at the actor's PDS blob endpoint for accounts bluesky's CDN no longer serves.

associated.description: Pass-through of app.bsky.actor.defs#profileAssociated as last seen from the actor's profile (lists, feedgens, starter packs, chat settings); absent if never observed.

labels.description: Pass-through of the actor's com.atproto.label.defs#label array (self-labels and moderation-service labels) as last seen; may be empty.

createdAt.description: Account creation time as reported by the actor's profile view; absent if unknown.
